label: Peter G. Bergmann
narrative: Peter G. Bergmann of Syracuse University sat on the six-member steering committee of the January 1957 Conference on the Role of Gravitation in Physics at Chapel Hill and delivered its closing summary. The conference report, issued as Wright Air Development Center Technical Report 57-216, prints him among its forty-six participants. He reaches this board because the board already carries the Chapel Hill conference through Louis Witten and the Institute of Field Physics, and because a guest in the Danny Jones corpus names him. Everything asserted here comes from the conference report's own front matter; nothing about his other work or affiliations has been opened.
